title: Go to Vidfield, open the canvas, upload your image, select Seedance 2, and…
content: Go to Vidfield, open the canvas, upload your image, select Seedance 2, and generate the video.
tips: Go to Vidfield, open the canvas, upload your image, select Seedance 2, and generate the video.

es.content: Ve a Vidfield, abre el lienzo, sube tu imagen, selecciona Seedance 2 y genera el video.

fr.content: Allez sur Vidfield, ouvrez le canevas, téléchargez votre image, sélectionnez Seedance 2, et générez la vidéo.

ja.content: Vidfieldにアクセスし、キャンバスを開き、画像をアップロードし、Seedance 2を選択してビデオを生成します。

ko.content: Vidfield로 이동하여 캔버스를 열고 이미지를 업로드한 후 Seedance 2를 선택하고 비디오를 생성하세요.

pt.content: Vá para o Vidfield, abra a tela, faça o upload da sua imagem, selecione Seedance 2 e gere o vídeo.

zh.content: 前往Vidfield，打开画布，上传你的图像，选择Seedance 2，然后生成视频。
